author: More Perfect Union
description:
Trump is pushing for the AI data center takeover of America while he stands to personally profit from it.

We dug through Trump's financial disclosures, and discovered that he secretly bought up to $25 million in the handful of construction firms building out the AI data center boom Americans are actively opposing. Some of those same companies saw their stocks nearly double in value since Trump took office.

It’s not just Big Tech donors getting rich off pro-AI policies – we followed the money back to Trump himself.

Producer/Host: Lucy Stockton 
Editor: niklaak
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: I dug into Trump’s financial disclosures. He’s making millions off data centers.
